title: gentiana germanica subsp. carpatica
intro: Gentiana germanica subsp. carpatica, commonly known as Alpine Gentian, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Gentianaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including digestive problems, fever, and inflammation, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Gentian include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as gentiopicroside, gentiin, and loganin. These constituents have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and gastroprotective effects, making Alpine Gentian a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
